scope: All Modal CLI and SDK calls in the 333-file prior frozen manifest; pinned local Modal 1.6.1 implementation inspected

cli_paths.confirmation: Pinned CLI calls confirm_or_suggest_yes only when yes is false

sdk_paths.finding: App.run defaults interactive=False; silent SDK execution uses configured credentials and no confirmation prompt or terminal input
Protocol requests do not prompt; from_env uses configured credentials or raises; no login/browser/TTY flow. Stop and cancellation are separate detached bounded subprocesses
Declarative recipe/decorator APIs and SDK volume operations do not prompt or require a TTY; released dispatch loads only the content-bound prebuilt image
Historical frozen 6502 tooling is outside the S2 launch path; its SDK calls are noninteractive and its modal run examples do not request confirmations or interactive shells

new_launch_volume_download: SDK Volume.from_name/read_file, exact exclusive local writes, no interactive CLI or overwrite prompt
